text: Yes, the forest on this 58.1-hectare rural property was cleared in 2023. About 0.7 hectares of tree cover was lost, which is approximately 1.2% of the property. The evidence shows this area was forested in 2020 and that the loss was detected in 2023. The cleared area was primarily planted forest (0.4 hectares), with some outside mapped forest (0.3 hectares). The change was small but confirmed by multiple sources. However, the cause (e.g., logging, fire) and legality of the clearing cannot be determined from this data.
